DESCRIPTION: A Shure SLX-D receiver, an SLXD4 or SLXD4D, over its command strings on TCP 2202: each channel's gain, name, frequency and identify (SLX-D has no mute command); its pack's battery; and its meters once a second while Rx is on. Two channels described.

SOURCES: Shure, SLX-D Command Strings, version 2 (2020-G): TCP 2202; the device, channel, metering and side channel strings; SAMPLE x ALL audPeak audRms rfRssi

cross-read, not copied: bitfocus/companion-module-shure-wireless (MIT), its help page: the actions and feedbacks it offers per range, and that it sends `< GET 0 ALL >` and `< SET 0 METER_RATE ... >` with no line end and cuts what it reads at `>`

FW_VER.DESCRIPTION: The firmware, Maj.Min.Pack.Build; a star after it, a self test failed.

LOCK_STATUS.DESCRIPTION: The front panel's lock: OFF, MENU, ALL.

FLASH.DESCRIPTION: Flash the lights to find it: on, and the receiver stops by itself.

AUDIO_GAIN.DESCRIPTION: The channel's audio gain, -18 to +42 dB in steps of one; the receiver counts it from nought, 18 below, and the wire adds and takes off the 18.

CHAN_NAME.DESCRIPTION: The channel's name: eight characters set, thirty-one heard.

AUDIO_OUT_LVL_SWITCH.DESCRIPTION: The output's switch, MIC or LINE.

FREQUENCY.DESCRIPTION: The receive frequency in kHz, 578350 for 578.350 MHz.

GROUP_CHANNEL.DESCRIPTION: The group and channel, 6,100; --,-- when the frequency was set directly.

FREQUENCY2.DESCRIPTION: The second frequency of a channel in FD-C, in kHz.

FD_MODE.DESCRIPTION: Frequency diversity, as the receiver words it.

FLASH.DESCRIPTION: Flash the lights to find it: on, and the receiver stops by itself.

METER_RATE.DESCRIPTION: How often the receiver sends its meters, in milliseconds: nought off, else 100 to 65535. Go.dot asks for 1000 on every opening while the device's Rx is on.

AUDIO_LEVEL_PEAK.DESCRIPTION: The peak audio level, -120 to 0 dBFS. Metered.

AUDIO_LEVEL_RMS.DESCRIPTION: The RMS audio level, -120 to 0 dBFS. Metered.

RSSI.DESCRIPTION: The RF level at an antenna, -120 to 0 dBm; the meters' one value is kept as the first. Metered. By antenna, from one.

1.DESCRIPTION: The RF level at an antenna, -120 to 0 dBm; the meters' one value is kept as the first. Metered.

2.DESCRIPTION: The RF level at an antenna, -120 to 0 dBm; the meters' one value is kept as the first. Metered.

TX_MODEL.DESCRIPTION: The transmitter: SLXD1, SLXD2, or UNKNOWN.

TX_BATT_BARS.DESCRIPTION: Battery bars, 0 to 5; 255 unknown - no pack, or one that does not say.

TX_BATT_MINS.DESCRIPTION: Battery minutes left, 0 to 65532; 65533 a battery warning, 65534 still calculating, 65535 unknown.
